headlines.title: Seagate Sinks 8%, Western Digital Down 6% on Election, Memory Price Worries
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysSeagate shares fell 8% today as investors sold data center and storage stocks after the midterm elections, with Western Digital down too. Seagate has little exposure to flash memory prices, and most of its drive supply is allocated under contracts through 2028, so the drop looks overdone.

headlines.title: Seagate Revenue Soars 61% in Q1: Can This Momentum Continue?
headlines.summary: STX's fiscal 2027 starts strong with surging revenues, record cash flow and rising HAMR adoption, fueled by AI demand and favorable pricing trends.

headlines.title: Micron, Nvidia, and AMD lead chip stocks' rebound
headlines.summary: Chip stocks rebounded on Tuesday, reversing tech's heavy recent sell-off.

headlines.title: Seagate Was Supposed to Lose to SSDs. Here’s What $1,000 Invested 10 Years Ago Became
headlines.summary: Hard drives were supposed to die quietly as flash storage took over, yet Seagate shareholders who held through a brutal downturn found themselves sitting on returns that crushed the S&P 500 at every horizon. The real question now is whether the AI-fueled surge has more room to run or already peaked.

headlines.title: Seagate's $1.2 Billion Debt Paydown: What Comes Next for Investors?
headlines.summary: STX's $1.2 billion debt paydown, surging free cash flow and higher dividend signal a shift toward shareholder returns, even as shares face valuation pressures.

description: Seagate Technology Holdings plc engages in providing data storage solutions in Singapore, the United States, the Netherlands, and internationally. The company offers External and internal hard drives; external and internal solid-state drives (SSDs); enterprise hard drives and SSDs; data storage systems; network attached storage (NAS) hard drives; video and analytics hard drives; and hyperscale and cloud solution. It offers its products for Healthcare, Media & Entertainment, Surveillance & Security, and telecommunication industry. The company sells its products primarily to original equipment manufacturers, distributors, and retailers. The company was founded in 1978 and is based in Singapore.
